performance.verdict: Paid ads dark 28+ days; organic holding but GBP has gone silent.

findings.text: Meta and Google spend = $0 for all 28 days in window; 0 leads, 0 CPL — paid engine is fully off.
⛔ Extension with Marwan unsigned past Aug 31 deadline; engagement is month-to-month lapsed, gating next 3 months.
⛔ SMS automation and Zoho Voice access both overdue since Aug 31; contact-rate bottleneck remains unresolved.
GBP actions dropped to 0 for 7 consecutive days (Sep 1–6) after averaging ~8/day in August — listing or tracking issue likely.
Search Console clicks averaging ~33/day (Sep 1–5) and GA4 sessions holding ~73/day — organic is the only active traffic channel.

suggestions.text: Investigate and restore GBP listing — 0 actions for 7 days vs 8/day August average signals a suspension or tracking break.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped from ~8/day in August to 0 for all 7 days Sep 1–6, a confirmed break. Check for listing suspension, ownership issue, or UTM tracking failure on the GBP profile. Success = GBP actions resume at ≥5/day. Re-check by Sep 10.

suggestions.text: Escalate Marwan extension signature immediately — lapsed contract blocks restarting the $65–75/day Meta spend.
